faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Telegram video downloader, Chrome extension, and this companion site

q1.question: Is this site an online Telegram video downloader or Telegram downloader?
q1.answer: No — this domain is informational only. The real Telegram downloader works as a Chrome extension after you install it from the Chrome Web Store: you use Telegram Web in Chrome, and download Telegram video and other media in the browser, not by pasting links here.

q2.question: Do I need to log in on this website to download Telegram videos?
q2.answer: No login on our site. To download Telegram video or files from private groups and channels you already joined, sign in only through official Telegram Web or the Telegram app — never enter your password on unrelated third-party forms.

q3.question: Can I use this Telegram video downloader in private groups and channels?
q3.answer: Yes, for chats you can open in Telegram Web in Chrome — including many private groups and public channels — the extension can help you save video, images, GIFs, audio, and files you are allowed to access, subject to Telegram’s rules and your permissions.

q4.question: Does it handle large Telegram downloads (e.g. long HD video)?
q4.answer: Yes — stable downloads for 1GB+ files are supported when your network and Telegram allow, so large channel or group files often work fine.

q5.question: Is there a mobile Telegram channel downloader or Telegram group video downloader?
q5.answer: This product is a desktop Chrome extension, not a mobile Telegram video downloader app. On phones, use Telegram’s official apps; do not try to run desktop-only extensions on mobile browsers.

q6.question: Is it OK to save any Telegram video from a group or channel?
q6.answer: Only save content you are legally and ethically allowed to keep. Use this Telegram media downloader for personal backup and organization — respect copyright, creators, and Telegram’s terms of service.
